Run these as YOUR user (not root, not sudo). Nothing below has been run by this program.
test -x '/usr/local/bin/node' && test -f '/opt/nimblenewt/scripts/nimblenewt-launcher.mjs' && test -d '/home/ann/nimblenewt/releases-root'
test -f '/home/ann/.config/nimblenewt/nimblenewt.env' && chmod 600 '/home/ann/.config/nimblenewt/nimblenewt.env'   # your KEY=value lines; the unit only names this file
mkdir -p -m 700 '/home/ann/.local/state/nimblenewt'
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
cat > "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"/nimblenewt.service <<'NIMBLENEWT_UNIT_END'
# Generated by nimblenewt-service.mjs. It holds no secrets: keep them in the environment file named below.
[Unit]
Description=NimbleNewt release launcher (nimblenewt)
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart="/usr/local/bin/node" "/opt/nimblenewt/scripts/nimblenewt-launcher.mjs" "--root" "/home/ann/nimblenewt/releases-root" "--entry" "controller.js" "--switcher" "pointer" "--" "--serve"
EnvironmentFile=/home/ann/.config/nimblenewt/nimblenewt.env
Restart=on-failure
RestartPreventExitStatus=2 3 4
RestartSec=30
KillMode=mixed
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStopSec=90
StandardOutput=append:/home/ann/.local/state/nimblenewt/nimblenewt.log
StandardError=append:/home/ann/.local/state/nimblenewt/nimblenewt.log
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
RestrictRealtime=true
LockPersonality=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
NIMBLENEWT_UNIT_END
systemd-analyze --user verify "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"/nimblenewt.service
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now nimblenewt.service
systemctl --user status nimblenewt.service
loginctl enable-linger "$USER"   # optional: keep it running when you are logged out
